nodes.Name: Attr
nodes.DocComment: An Attr is a key-value pair.

nodes.Name: String
nodes.DocComment: String returns an Attr for a string value.

nodes.Name: Int64
nodes.DocComment: Int64 returns an Attr for an int64.

nodes.Name: Int
nodes.DocComment:
Int converts an int to an int64 and returns
an Attr with that value.

nodes.Name: Uint64
nodes.DocComment: Uint64 returns an Attr for a uint64.

nodes.Name: Float64
nodes.DocComment: Float64 returns an Attr for a floating-point number.

nodes.Name: Bool
nodes.DocComment: Bool returns an Attr for a bool.

nodes.Name: Time
nodes.DocComment:
Time returns an Attr for a [time.Time].
It discards the monotonic portion.

nodes.Name: Duration
nodes.DocComment: Duration returns an Attr for a [time.Duration].

nodes.Name: Group
nodes.DocComment:
Group returns an Attr for a Group [Value].
The first argument is the key; the remaining arguments
are converted to Attrs as in [Logger.Log].

Use Group to collect several key-value pairs under a single
key on a log line, or as the result of LogValue
in order to log a single value as multiple Attrs.

nodes.Name: GroupAttrs
nodes.DocComment:
GroupAttrs returns an Attr for a Group [Value]
consisting of the given Attrs.

GroupAttrs is a more efficient version of [Group]
that accepts only [Attr] values.

nodes.Name: Any
nodes.DocComment:
Any returns an Attr for the supplied value.
See [AnyValue] for how values are treated.

nodes.Name: Equal
nodes.DocComment: Equal reports whether a and b have equal keys and values.

nodes.Name: isEmpty
nodes.DocComment:
isEmpty reports whether a has an empty key and a nil value.
That can be written as Attr{} or Any("", nil).
